collectionOrderKeys.comparison: .NET ordinal Unicode code-unit order over the complete composite key
collectionOrderKeys.prefixExample: cli-tests|... sorts before cli|... because '-' (U+002D) sorts before '|' (U+007C)

lockScaffold.reads: only the exact contained definition path and definition- or intent-named local assets
lockScaffold.doesNot: scan, restore, query a feed, load an assembly, infer a semantic choice, or overwrite output

digestProjections.inputDigest: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON containing the exact definition reference, exact lock intent, repeated exact toolchain tuple, and stable local-asset path/digest rows; absolute repository and output paths are excluded
digestProjections.outputDigest: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON for the complete alpha.1 selection lock with outputDigest omitted
digestProjections.bind: re-reads the exact definition and every named local asset, recomputes both projections, and rejects any candidate difference

expectedReceiptDerivation.cardinality: one distinct receipt for every activation projectProfileId, selected analyzerComponentId, and verificationProfile tuple
expectedReceiptDerivation.identity: receiptIdentityNamespace name joined with projectProfileId name, analyzerComponentId name, and verificationProfile by hyphens under the supplied receipt namespace scope

generatedProjectVerification.optionalGateOwner: Orbyss.ProgramKit.CSharpBuildGates.Build when an exact generated-output activation is configured

publicAnalyzerSelections.packageSha256Evidence: exact package digest from the selected Program Kit release asset manifest
